title: Equity Brief — 24 Sep 2026
intro: Markets trade in RISK OFF mode with defensive rotation pressuring cyclicals and growth names amid pre-market weakness in US futures. Asia shows divergence with Japan outperforming on yen weakness while China and Hong Kong lag on persistent property sector concerns.

sections.heading: 📈 EQUITY SUMMARY
sections.content: Markets trade in RISK OFF mode with defensive rotation pressuring cyclicals and growth names amid pre-market weakness in US futures. Asia shows divergence with Japan outperforming on yen weakness while China and Hong Kong lag on persistent property sector concerns.

sections.heading: 🌍 INDEX RANKING
sections.content:
Nikkei 225: 65,514 +0.76% — Yen depreciation boosting exporter sentiment, best performer
S&P 500: 767.81 -0.72% — Tech drag offsetting resilient financials
Nasdaq: 26,936 -0.69% — Alphabet selloff weighing on sentiment
CAC 40: 8,123 -0.19% — Luxury stocks providing defensive support
FTSE 100: 10,705 -0.31% — Energy sector limiting downside
Hang Seng: 24,732 -0.41% — Mainland weakness spilling into Hong Kong
🇺🇸 US MARKET
S&P 500 at 767.81 holds above 765 support with neutral bias pending manufacturing data. Nasdaq 26,936 faces resistance at 27,100 as semiconductor weakness offsets AI infrastructure strength. Dow 51,512 breaks below 51,600, led lower by industrial names on global growth concerns.
🇪🇺 EUROPE
DAX 25,411 -0.64% underperforms on auto sector weakness tied to China demand fears.
FTSE 100 10,705 -0.31% resilient on energy and defense sector bids.
CAC 40 8,123 -0.19% outperforms region as LVMH and Hermes attract safe-haven flows.
💻 TECH FOCUS
Meta 744.10 +1.02% leading mega caps on analyst upgrades citing AI monetization acceleration and Threads user growth exceeding 500 million. Alphabet 337.83 -3.80% worst performer after DOJ antitrust filing seeks structural remedies including potential Search divestiture.

sections.heading: 🎯 TRADE IDEAS
sections.content:
LONG: Meta 744.10 on AI revenue inflection, entry 742-745, SL 728, TP 785.
LONG: Nikkei 225 futures on yen tailwinds and technical breakout, entry 65,400, SL 64,800, TP 66,500.
SHORT/AVOID: Alphabet facing regulatory overhang with potential multi-quarter uncertainty on business model.

sections.heading: ⚠️ RISKS
sections.content: DOJ antitrust escalation could trigger broader tech regulation fears spreading to other mega caps. China property contagion risk rising with developer missed payments accelerating.
